answer.note: no HIRC Event in any bank `AUDIO_BANKS.md` lists carries this id

method.chunks: BKHD-located Wwise chunk chain; 4-char magic + u32 size, walked to the payload end
method.events: HIRC: u32 count then u8 type + u32 size + body; type 0x04, id = first u32 of the body
method.payload: export bytes [offset, offset+size) of the package image, chunk-decompressed block by block (only the blocks the payload occupies)

O-2-hirc_complete_and_counts.note: a payload whose BKHD sits at a non-zero offset is a bank wrapped in an export that also holds a `BKPK` blob; its chain ends at that blob, and the blob is not parsed as a container

O-4-raw_u32_agrees_with_the_parse.note: the payload is stored uncompressed, so the id must also appear as a raw little-endian u32 exactly where the HIRC walk found it, and nowhere else
